property_summary: After calling newEmergencyOracle, the owner of the created EmergencyOracle contract is the original msg.sender.
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the EmergencyOracle contract's price is 0.
The jojoTeam state variable remains unchanged after newEmergencyOracle is called.
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the EmergencyOracle contract's owner (accessible via the owner() function) must be the address that was passed as msg.sender.
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the description of the created EmergencyOracle contract equals the description passed as argument.
The description of the newly created EmergencyOracle matches the input description string passed to newEmergencyOracle.
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the contract C's newEmergencyOracle event correctly reports the new oracle address whose description matches the input parameter.
The description of the EmergencyOracle created by newEmergencyOracle(string) is equal to the input description string.
The EmergencyOracle created by newEmergencyOracle has a non-empty description when the input description is non-empty.
After calling newEmergencyOracle(string), the address of the newly created EmergencyOracle is not the zero address.
After calling newEmergencyOracle(string), the event NewEmergencyOracle is emitted with the first argument equal to the caller's address, not necessarily the jojoTeam address.
The newEmergencyOracle function only succeeds when called by jojoTeam.
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the new oracle's owner (returned by the oracle's owner() getter) equals the caller of newEmergencyOracle, not the jojoTeam address.
The emit of NewEmergencyOracle always matches that the caller is the owner of the new EmergencyOracle.
After calling newEmergencyOracle(string), the newly created EmergencyOracle's owner() equals the caller of newEmergencyOracle.
The newEmergencyOracle function should emit the address of the newly created oracle contract, not the address of the C contract.
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the event NewEmergencyOracle should include the address of the newly created EmergencyOracle contract, not the address of C.
The event NewEmergencyOracle must emit the address of the newly created EmergencyOracle contract, not address(this).
The event NewEmergencyOracle should emit the address of the newly created oracle, not the C contract address.
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the event NewEmergencyOracle emits the address of the newly created EmergencyOracle contract.
